sources.title: IUPAC Graphical representation standards for chemical structure diagrams (2008)
sources.actualAccess: official indexed primary-source text returned by search
sources.paraphrase: Implicit carbon nodes are represented by the geometry of bonded lines. The candidate adds branch junctions midway along drawn ring edges, so the intended six-carbon aromatic ring is not preserved.

sources.paraphrase: Arenium sigma adducts are Wheland intermediates in electrophilic aromatic substitution; this supports classifying the central nonaromatic sigma-complex correctly.
